description: The negative test for the NEW agent-session registrations, executed against the shared core script that every adapter renders. In a session with no Overlord binding this must produce no output, no subprocess, no file, and no delay — the bash gate runs before the `ovld` spawn, so the assertion below is empty cliInvocations rather than a tolerated one. This is what narrows the `unbound-session-side-effects` hazard: the new path is silent, and only the legacy record-touched hook still spawns.
